identical_stories_on_repeat_notes: Currently, running `/story lighthouse` 10 times consecutively with a running local LLM produces 10 unique hashes. This is because the default LLM temperature (0.8 or overridden by chaos to ~0.89) is non-zero, ensuring probabilistic variance. However, because the prompts are identical, caching at the provider or model layer would result in 100% duplicate rate. Adding the Lorenz attractor parameters (tick, nonce, cabinet echoes) to the prompt will mathematically guarantee prompt uniqueness and break any caching layers.
